findings.issue: No `needs: ci` in deploy-dev job. Both workflows triggered in parallel on push to dev. Deploy could race CI and execute even when CI is red, relying on external branch-protection rather than declarative workflow dependency.
findings.suggestion: Implemented as workflow_run trigger (option б — canonical cross-workflow gating pattern). `needs:` is only valid within a single workflow; cross-workflow dependency requires workflow_run. Gate: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' — deploy job is skipped for any non-success conclusion (failure, cancelled, timed_out, etc.).
findings.resolution: workflow_run trigger on ci workflow with conclusion==success gate. Dormant gate preserved via && secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY != ''. Commit: 3be1262.

findings.issue: ssh-keyscan TOFU: accepts any key the host presents without fingerprint validation. Risk mitigated by Tailscale WireGuard PKI for this dev private network, but not explicitly documented.
findings.suggestion: Add comment explicitly documenting the TOFU decision and Tailscale mitigation.
findings.resolution: Extended comment in Install SSH key step documents TOFU acceptance rationale: Tailscale WireGuard PKI, dev-only context. Commit: 3be1262.

findings.issue: Secret DEPLOY_SSH_KEY directly interpolated via ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }} in run: shell command. GitHub masks it in logs, but value appears in expanded shell command before masking.
findings.suggestion: Use env: SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }} at step level and reference $SSH_KEY in the run script.
findings.resolution: Moved to env: SSH_KEY: block; run: uses $SSH_KEY. Commit: 3be1262.

findings.issue: No explicit `permissions:` block. Workflow uses only checkout (read). Default permissions on public repo are broader than needed.
findings.suggestion: Add `permissions: contents: read` at workflow or job level.
findings.resolution: Added `permissions: contents: read` at workflow level. Commit: 3be1262.

findings.issue: docker-compose.override.yml not in .gitignore. If accidentally staged, the next deploy reset --hard would delete it, breaking restart-policy for the dev stack.
findings.resolution: Added to .gitignore with explanatory comment. Commit: 3be1262.

findings.issue: Unescaped command substitution $(git log --oneline -1) inside double-quoted SSH argument. Outer shell expands on runner before sending to SSH; server receives local runner HEAD hash, not server HEAD after pull.
findings.suggestion: Escape to \$(git log --oneline -1) so it runs on the remote server.
findings.resolution: Changed to \$(git log --oneline -1). Dry-run confirms literal $(git log --oneline -1) reaches remote. Commit: 3be1262.

acceptance_coverage.ac: Workflow НЕ касается main и prod-кредов
Deploy triggered only on CI success (workflow_run conclusion==success)

re_review.r1_justification: needs: is intra-workflow only; cross-workflow gating requires workflow_run. conclusion==success provably blocks deploy on any non-success CI outcome. Dormant gate preserved.

role_gap_evidence: T-0008 combines infrastructure automation with SSH key handling and public-repo security constraints. Recurring pattern of security-axis findings (R-1..R-3) on deploy/CI tasks suggests candidacy for a dedicated security-reviewer role — log in ledgers/role-gaps.md (SQ11).
